title.en: Answering the Phone and Taking Messages

scene.ko: 출장 중이라 연락이 안 되는 동료를 급하게 찾는 거래처 전화를 받아, 내용을 정확히 받아 적고 해결 방법을 제안한다.

lines.en: Good morning, Dasol Tech sales team. Yuna speaking.
alt: Good morning, Dasol Tech sales. This is Yuna.
Dasol Tech sales team, this is Yuna. How may I help you?

lines.en: Hi, this is Greg Novak from Tallis Logistics. I've been trying to reach Eric Shin all morning, and it's pretty urgent.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 탤리스 로지스틱스의 그레그 노박입니다. 아침 내내 에릭 신 씨와 연락하려고 했는데요, 꽤 급한 일이에요.

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. Eric is on a flight to Singapore right now, but I can take a detailed message for him.
lines.ko: 죄송합니다. 에릭 씨가 지금 싱가포르로 가는 비행기 안에 계신데요, 제가 메시지를 자세히 받아 둘게요.
alt: Sorry about that. Eric is flying to Singapore at the moment, but I can take a message for him.

lines.en: Okay. One of our trucks broke down, so tomorrow's shipment won't arrive until Thursday. He needs to approve a new delivery plan today.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 저희 트럭 한 대가 고장 나서, 내일 도착할 화물이 목요일에야 도착할 거예요. 에릭 씨가 오늘 안에 새 배송 계획을 승인해 주셔야 하고요.

lines.en: I see. Just to make sure I get everything right, could you spell your last name for me?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 정확하게 적어 두려고 하는데요, 성 철자를 불러 주시겠어요?
alt: Understood. Could you spell your last name, please?
Got it. How do you spell your last name?

lines.en: Thank you. So the shipment is delayed until Thursday, and Eric needs to approve a new plan by the end of today. Is that correct?
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 그러니까 화물이 목요일로 늦어지고, 에릭 씨가 오늘 업무 끝나기 전까지 새 계획을 승인해야 한다는 거죠. 맞나요?
alt: Thanks. So the shipment won't come until Thursday, and he has to approve a new plan today. Is that right?

lines.en: Exactly. But if he's on a plane, he won't see this in time, will he?
lines.ko: 맞아요. 그런데 비행기 안에 계시면 제때 못 보시겠네요?

lines.en: He lands at three, so I'll text him right away. In the meantime, would you like me to put you through to his manager, Ms. Kang?
lines.ko: 3시에 도착하시니까 바로 문자 드릴게요. 그동안 에릭 씨 팀장님이신 강 팀장님께 연결해 드릴까요?
alt: His flight lands at three, so I'll send him a text now. Would you like to speak to his manager, Ms. Kang, in the meantime?

lines.en: Yes, that would be great. Thanks for handling this so quickly.
lines.ko: 네, 그러면 좋겠어요. 이렇게 빨리 처리해 주셔서 고마워요.

expressions.en: I can take a detailed message for ___.
expressions.note: take a message = 메시지를 받아 두다

expressions.en: Could you spell your last name for me?
expressions.note: last name = 성 · first name = 이름
받아 적은 내용을 정리해 확인할 때
기다리는 사이에 할 일을 말할 때

expressions.en: Would you like me to put you through to ___?
